latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the automate-excel skill.
- Provides scripts to automate common Excel tasks such as merging, filtering, splitting, deduplication, aggregation, and CSV/Excel conversion.
- Supports both modern (.xlsx) and legacy (.xls) file formats; compatible with typical business table processing needs.
- Includes batch processing tips, error handling guidance, and quick code examples using openpyxl and pandas.
- Full documentation with script usage, typical parameters, and troubleshooting in SKILL.md.
